&Quick Shifter       
Enable point(r.p.m.x100)
Delay count  to activation(pick-up count)
Count of ignition cuts(pick-up count)
Count of Invalid after activation(pick-up count)
Reverse on/off state
Use as stop switch
Set the minimum engine speed (RPM) at which the quickshifter switch becomes active. Using the quickshifter at low RPM is not recommended. The default value is 70.
Set the number of crankshaft revolutions that must occur after the quick shifter switch is activated before the ignition cut engages. The default value is zero.
Set the duration of the ignition cut. The default value is 11 for single-cylinder engines and 22 for twin-cylinder engines.
Set the engine speed threshold to inhibit the quick shifter switch from re-engaging after the ignition cut period has ended.
Inverts the quickshifter switch setting (ON/OFF). Please configure this according to the switch specifications. The default setting is OFF.
Turn this on when using the quick-shifter switch as a STOP switch. It is not normally used. The default setting is OFF.
